name: send_command
description: Send a command to a device to control its behavior (turn on/off, set a value, change mode, run query, etc.). Supply value/unit only for commands that take one -- most commands (on/off/query/etc.) take none.

device_id.description: The device's real id, exactly as shown for it in DEVICE DATABASE.

command.description: The command's exact display name, exactly as shown in this device's 'accepts' list in DEVICE DATABASE -- not an id.

value.description: The value to set, parsed from what the customer said: a plain number, or the exact enum label text shown for this command if it's an enumerated choice (e.g. 'Program Auto'). Never a raw protocol id/key, never pre-converted. Omit for commands that take no value.

unit.description: The unit the customer stated for `value`, if any (e.g. 'celsius', 'minutes'). Omit if the customer didn't state one, or `value` is an enum label.
